name: Emperor crab
summary: The emperor crab of Đầm Ô Loan, red or yellow in the shell even while alive, with a tuft of short yellow hair. Its claws sit at the front, so it walks forward.
origin: Phu Yen. The crab is a specialty of Đầm Ô Loan.
howToEat: Order it as part of a lagoon seafood meal.
where: Đầm Ô Loan, 25 km north of the city.
seoTitle: Emperor crab at Dam O Loan — the crab that walks forward
seoDescription: Cua Huynh De from Dam O Loan is red or yellow even while alive and walks forward on its front-set claws.
